summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 58:12 Global Connect CRM - All core features working. Fixed critical bug in MembersPage.jsx where pendingMembers.map was failing due to incorrect API response handling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working: Login, Members page with gender Male/Female only, department based on location, Access Control with 5 restricted locations and all tabs (Residents, Staff, Guest Requests, Scan Log), Scan In/Out dialog, Reports & PDF export, CSV file upload in Quick Import, Document upload in member details, scroll overflow on all modals. Fixed bug: pendingMembers.map error - changed setPendingMembers(r.data) to setPendingMembers(r.data.members || []) in MembersPage.jsx line 79.

features_tested.department_by_location: PASS - Department dropdown populates based on selected location
features_tested.member_details_documents_tab: PASS - Shows upload form with Document Type, Label, File input (JPG/PNG only)
features_tested.access_control_page: PASS - Shows 5 restricted locations, all 4 tabs work (Residents, Staff Access, Guest Requests, Scan Log)
features_tested.scan_in_out_dialog: PASS - Opens with Scan Type (Resident/Staff), Member selector, Action (Scan IN/OUT)
features_tested.reports_page: PASS - Shows 8 stat cards, Generate Report works
features_tested.csv_file_upload: PASS - Quick Import dialog has CSV file upload input alongside paste textarea
features_tested.modal_scroll_overflow: PASS - All dialogs have max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto
features_tested.families_people_page: PASS - Family/Child/Guest dialogs all have scroll overflow

bug_fixed.issue: Members page crashing with 'pendingMembers.map is not a function' error
bug_fixed.root_cause: approvalsApi.pending() returns {members: [], total: 0} but code was setting setPendingMembers(r.data) instead of r.data.members
bug_fixed.fix: Changed line 79 in MembersPage.jsx from setPendingMembers(r.data) to setPendingMembers(r.data.members || [])
